notes: Wodonga: the twin city is named by Wikivoyage as "Wodonga" with Albury; if the owner wants "Albury-Wodonga", rename on apply.
Provisional pins: every spot with pin_status "provisional" has a coordinate from Wikipedia centroid or an estimate; a later pins stage runs resolve-pin.py. Trails need route midpoints.
Mount Buffalo Chalet: kept by skeptic though closed for years; Pipeline C must verify access before apply.
Glenrowan is kept beside Kellyland, Ned Kelly Museum and The Big Ned Kelly per the skeptic: the town streetscape (Wikivoyage page) is a draw; owner may drop the wrapper.
Harrietville is kept beside Tronoh Dredge Walking Track on the same grounds (Wikivoyage town page, Feathertop gateway).

Rutherglen, Eildon, Mount Beauty and Dinner Plain did not clear the spot bar, so no Rutherglen wine region destination: only Milawa and King Valley are kept in the wine country and sit under Wangaratta.
Mount Buller is not its own destination: only Stirling, Craig's Hut and Howitt are near it (3 spots), so it is the headline spot of Mansfield.

crossregion_decisions.reason: Had one new spot; the bar needs four. It only reached four by moving existing NSW spots (hume-dam, albury, murray-art-museum-albury) across a state line, which needs the owner. Tallangatta is standalone meanwhile; owner may approve Wodonga with those moves.
